queries.query: Find Backend Engineer candidates with Python and SQL, and at least 3 years of overall employment. Prefer FastAPI, PostgreSQL, Docker.

requirements.title: Backend Engineer — Python and SQL — 3+ years overall experience
requirements.source_text: Find Backend Engineer candidates with Python and SQL, and at least 3 years of overall employment. Prefer FastAPI, PostgreSQL, Docker.
requirements.semantic_brief: Find candidates for a Backend Engineer role, accepting equivalent backend engineering work, who have Python and SQL as independently mandatory skills and at least 3 years of overall employment. FastAPI, PostgreSQL, and Docker are preferred but optional. Overall employment is counted across documented employment, including internships or employment during study; no specific stack is inferred from the role alone.

evidence_standards.capability: Backend Engineer role or equivalent backend engineering work.
evidence_standards.sufficient_evidence: A source states a Backend Engineer or backend developer role, or describes equivalent backend engineering work, with enough context to identify the occupational function.
evidence_standards.equivalence_boundary: Different titles or wording can demonstrate the same backend engineering role when the described work is substantively backend-focused. Technology-specific evidence alone, without role or equivalent-work context, does not establish the role.
evidence_standards.uncertainty_boundary: No role evidence is absence of the role; vague engineering descriptions are ambiguous; conflicting role descriptions require resolution; missing dates do not prevent role evidence but limit duration assessment.

evidence_standards.sufficient_evidence: An explicit Python capability claim or source work demonstrating use of Python establishes presence.
evidence_standards.equivalence_boundary: Different wording or a narrower Python implementation can demonstrate the capability when it shows Python use. Adjacent languages, frameworks, or general programming alone do not establish Python capability.
evidence_standards.uncertainty_boundary: No Python evidence is absence of evidence, not inability; indirect or unclear references are ambiguous; contradictory sources require resolution; dates are not required for presence.

evidence_standards.sufficient_evidence: An explicit SQL capability claim or source work demonstrating use of SQL establishes presence.
evidence_standards.equivalence_boundary: Different wording or a narrower SQL implementation can demonstrate the capability when it shows SQL use. Adjacent database, query, or programming technology alone does not establish SQL capability.
evidence_standards.uncertainty_boundary: No SQL evidence is absence of evidence, not inability; indirect or unclear references are ambiguous; contradictory sources require resolution; dates are not required for presence.

evidence_standards.capability: At least 3 years of overall employment across documented employment periods.
evidence_standards.sufficient_evidence: Dated employment evidence, including documented employment across occupations and stated internships or employment during study, supports a total of at least 3 years under the source’s stated dates or durations.
evidence_standards.equivalence_boundary: Different employment titles, occupations, and documented employment arrangements may count toward total employment. Undated skills, projects, or isolated tasks do not establish an employment interval.
evidence_standards.uncertainty_boundary: Less than 3 documented years does not meet the threshold; absent dates or overlapping/unclear periods create uncertainty; missing resume details do not establish inability; contradictory dates require resolution.

evidence_standards.capability: FastAPI capability at presence level; preferred, not mandatory.
evidence_standards.sufficient_evidence: An explicit FastAPI capability claim or source work demonstrating use of FastAPI establishes preferred-skill presence.
evidence_standards.equivalence_boundary: Different wording or a narrower FastAPI implementation can demonstrate the capability when it shows FastAPI use. General Python web development or adjacent frameworks alone does not establish FastAPI capability.
evidence_standards.uncertainty_boundary: No FastAPI evidence indicates only that the preference is unverified; indirect or unclear references are ambiguous; contradictory sources require resolution; dates are not required.

evidence_standards.capability: PostgreSQL capability at presence level; preferred, not mandatory.
evidence_standards.sufficient_evidence: An explicit PostgreSQL capability claim or source work demonstrating use of PostgreSQL establishes preferred-skill presence.
evidence_standards.equivalence_boundary: Different wording or a narrower PostgreSQL implementation can demonstrate the capability when it shows PostgreSQL use. General database experience or adjacent database systems alone does not establish PostgreSQL capability.
evidence_standards.uncertainty_boundary: No PostgreSQL evidence indicates only that the preference is unverified; indirect or unclear references are ambiguous; contradictory sources require resolution; dates are not required.

evidence_standards.capability: Docker capability at presence level; preferred, not mandatory.
evidence_standards.sufficient_evidence: An explicit Docker capability claim or source work demonstrating use of Docker establishes preferred-skill presence.
evidence_standards.equivalence_boundary: Different wording or a narrower Docker implementation can demonstrate the capability when it shows Docker use. General deployment, virtualization, or adjacent container technology alone does not establish Docker capability.
evidence_standards.uncertainty_boundary: No Docker evidence indicates only that the preference is unverified; indirect or unclear references are ambiguous; contradictory sources require resolution; dates are not required.
